summary.text: Ben Bakeberg is a Republican state representative from House District 54B, in office since January 2023, who is the Republican candidate for Minnesota Senate District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a teacher, coach and school principal.

paragraphs.text: Ben Bakeberg was born in Cokato, Minnesota, and lives in Jordan, Minnesota.
He earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education from the University of Northwestern, St. Paul, and a master's degree in educational leadership from Minnesota State University, Mankato.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a custodian, paraprofessional, teacher, coach, assistant principal and building principal in public and private education.
Bakeberg took office in the Minnesota House on January 3, 2023, succeeding Tony Jurgens, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
